annotations.title: Boost a published X post (paused, proposed)

description:
[writes · `ads:manage` scope] Boosts a post the brand has already published on X, as published, through the brand's selected X Ads account. platform twitter (or x), postId (a flayr post id; ads_boost_candidates ranks them) or contentId, a whole-dollar daily budget at or above the X daily minimum, countries (2-letter codes), an end (endDate or durationDays), optional goal (engagement, traffic, awareness, video_views) and startDate. Created PAUSED in the owner's Proposed campaigns: nothing runs or spends until the owner approves it (ads_campaign_approve with activate). The exposure (daily x days) must fit the owner's caps. Answers 403 NETWORK_BOOST_DISABLED until the owner has switched X boosts on (ads_readiness networkSwitches shows it), 409 ADS_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED without a selected X Ads account; other platforms answer 400 PLATFORM_NOT_SUPPORTED. Pass agentName and reason. Audited in Ads > Agent activity.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/boosts.)

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

budget.description: Whole dollars per day, at or above the X daily minimum.

budgetType.description: X boosts take a daily budget only.

contentId.description: A Library item id whose post went out on X. One of postId or contentId.

countries.description: Required: ISO alpha-2 country codes, e.g. ["US"].

durationDays.description: Whole days, at least 1; instead of endDate.

endDate.description: ISO date or date-time; required unless durationDays is given.

goal.description: As the owner's X goal options allow (default: the owner's X default goal); video_views needs a video post.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; repeats with the same key return the first result instead of boosting twice.

platform.description: Only X boosts are open to a brand key.

postId.description: The flayr post id (GET /api/v2/posts, or ads boost candidates). One of postId or contentId.

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

startDate.description: ISO date or date-time; default now.
